authorization_basis: Explicit user instruction to continue after Phase 1 stopped and stated that separate Gate A authorization was required.

preexecution_implementation_contract.formation_scope: Development signal dates with at least one available IMOM6M feature and whose exact next global TSE month-end is no later than the registered development split end. The six-month lookback burn-in dates are not attempted formations.
preexecution_implementation_contract.outcome_scope: Only eligible formation rows are joined to exact formation and next-global-month-end adjusted closes.
preexecution_implementation_contract.missing_or_nonpositive_endpoint: The symbol outcome is missing. Do not substitute a prior or later close and do not remove only that symbol from an otherwise complete portfolio.
preexecution_implementation_contract.complete_month: Eligible cross-section count is at least 100, every eligible symbol has both valid endpoints and a finite next-month return, and rank IC is finite.
preexecution_implementation_contract.incomplete_month: Record counts and reason, exclude the entire month from Gate A metrics, and never backfill it.
preexecution_implementation_contract.decile_returns: Arithmetic equal-weight means for the preregistered formation-time deciles, with no cost or winsorization.
preexecution_implementation_contract.rank_ic: Pearson correlation of average ascending ranks of IMOM6M and next-month return across the complete eligible cross-section.
preexecution_implementation_contract.chronological_halves: Sort complete months by formation date; first floor(n/2) months versus the remainder.
preexecution_implementation_contract.largest_month_removal: Remove exactly the complete month with the highest D10-minus-D1 spread, breaking ties by earliest formation date.
preexecution_implementation_contract.pass_rule: All preregistered Gate A conditions must be strictly greater than zero and the complete-month count must be at least 24.
